name: Kusanagi Kasumi
source:
An intelligent and very sensitive girl, she thinks deeply about the world and the people in it, but sometimes has trouble trusting them. Kasumi's fear of growing up gives her great anxiety about the future.

[from [url=http://www.shira-oka.com/characters/28-kusanagi-kasumi.html]official site[/url]]
